title: Republican Midterm Convention Kicks Off | Radio Balance of Power: Early Edition 9/9/2026
description:
On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Kailey Leinz is in Dallas for the Republican midterm convention. On today's show, convention co-chair Ray Washburne, Lone Star Project Founder Matt Angle, Republican Strategist Vinny Minchillo and US Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins.
